approvals.note: Recorded by the Claude worker under Leif's 2026-11-10 standing rule: bug fixes that make behavior match existing requirements may run the full lifecycle with 0xLeif as actor. Scope: one deps error per missing dependency per the deps acceptance criteria (#606).

approved_scope.title: Deps reports one missing dependency as one error
approved_scope.description: deps reports one missing dependency as one error
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: The deps acceptance criterion already says validate_deps reports an error for each declared dependency whose target has no spec; one missing dependency produced two errors. This makes the count match the existing requirement
acceptance_criteria: a spec whose depends_on names a module with no spec yields exactly one deps error for it, the 'Dependency spec not found' verdict check gives, for bare and path entries; missing_deps still names the edge; the regression_w1 pin now expects one occurrence

answers.constraints: the edge stays in the graph so missing_deps and the JSON keep naming the target; the public DepNode shape is unchanged
